description: A value built by a callback that returns functions fires E-VALUE-FUNCTION-STORED (§14.3). `items.map((i) => () => pick(i))` builds an array of closures — a value holding functions. Bind the call at the use site instead (`<each in=@items as i><button onclick=pick(i)>`). Incidental W-PROGRAM-SPA-INFERRED is ignored by superset matching.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S464 "(a) Close it" (the closure-array entry — a value built by a callback that returns functions is refused)
rationale: §14.3 `.map` / `.flatMap` / `Array.from(xs, f)` / `m.update(k, f)` results are judged by what the callback returns; a callback returning a function builds a value holding functions.
